line: Crowley’s Four of Wands: Completion, Chesed in the suit of Fire, with Venus in Aries.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter name for the card. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: In the Wand suit, the card is called Completion.
“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

sections.title: Its place on the Tree and in the zodiac
sections.line: The card refers to Chesed in the suit of Fire and is also referred to Venus in Aries.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Chesed in the suit of Fire.
It is also referred to Venus in Aries

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley reads the card as the Will built into a solid system, and places it below the Abyss.

quotes.quote: Being below the Abyss, it is the Lord of all manifested active Power.
